content.scope: Costs associated with exit/disposal activities (restructuring, plant closings, workforce reductions)
content.key_principle: Recognize liability when incurred (NOT when management commits to plan). Measure at fair value.

types_of_costs.one_time_termination_benefits: Severance pay, outplacement services provided to terminated employees
types_of_costs.contract_termination_costs: Costs to terminate contract before end of term (lease termination penalty)

one_time_termination_benefits.when_recognized: At communication date (when employer communicates arrangement to employees AND meets specific criteria)
one_time_termination_benefits.criteria: 1) Arrangement communicated to employees, 2) Specifies termination benefits, 3) Unlikely to change significantly
one_time_termination_benefits.measurement: Fair value of liability (typically PV of expected payments)
one_time_termination_benefits.entry: DR Restructuring Expense, CR Termination Benefits Payable

contract_termination_costs.when_recognized: When entity terminates contract (cease using rights) or incurs termination penalty
contract_termination_costs.lease_termination: Recognize when entity ceases using leased property (not when commits to exit)
contract_termination_costs.measurement: PV of remaining lease payments less estimated sublease rentals (or termination penalty if less)
contract_termination_costs.entry: DR Loss on Contract Termination, CR Lease Termination Liability

other_exit_costs.not_accrued_upfront: Cannot accrue for future operating losses or costs not yet incurred
other_exit_costs.example: Relocation costs recognized when relocation occurs (not when plan announced)

example_termination_benefits.scenario: Company announces workforce reduction. Communicate severance plan to 100 employees on Dec 1. $5K per employee. Payments over 6 months. Discount rate 6%.
example_termination_benefits.calculation: Total $500K. PV of payments over 6 months (if material, discount).
example_termination_benefits.entry: DR Restructuring Expense $500K (or PV), CR Termination Benefits Payable $500K

example_lease_termination.scenario: Company vacates leased facility on March 31. Remaining lease payments $100K. Can sublease for $30K.
example_lease_termination.entry: DR Loss on Lease Termination $70K, CR Lease Termination Liability $70K

ongoing_benefits_vs_one_time.one_time: Special termination benefits for specific event (recognized at communication date)
ongoing_benefits_vs_one_time.ongoing: Normal severance per policy (recognized over service period or when probable)

disclosure_requirements: Total expected costs and amounts incurred to date

comparison_to_contingencies.asc_420: Liability when incurred (service received or contract terminated)
comparison_to_contingencies.key_difference: ASC 420 more specific timing (not just probable)

cpa_exam_tips: Liability recognized when INCURRED (not when plan committed)
Termination benefits: Communication date (if meets criteria)
Lease termination: When cease using property (not when plan announced)
Other costs: When goods/services received (expense as incurred)
Cannot accrue future operating losses or costs not yet incurred

key_points: Liability when incurred (not when plan committed)
Lease termination: When cease using property
No accrual for future operating losses
Measure at fair value (PV if material)
